# Cranfill Sumner LLP

> A full-service law firm combining big firm expertise with cost-efficient legal services across North Carolina.

Cranfill Sumner LLP is a North Carolina-based law firm with offices in Charlotte, Raleigh, and Wilmington. The firm serves clients across multiple practice areas including employment law, mergers & acquisitions, and litigation, with a strong commitment to diversity, community involvement, and attorney excellence.
